body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0187 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "Clear PowerShell history via process - Behavior: Clear PowerShell history via process. Anchor is process+flag or event id+field after classic/XML coalesce. Not telemetry_validated. Sysmon 1 Remove-Item PSReadLine history"
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0187"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1070.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINDOWS_SYSMON"
    ($e.target.process.command_line = /ConsoleHost_history/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /Clear-History/ nocase or $e.target.process.command_line = /^.*Remove-Item.*history.*$/ nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
